CustomField.description: Maximum model tokens (input plus output, as the provider reports them) for one run, or for each reply of a conversational agent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Use a whole number from 1,000 to 100,000,000. Blank uses 250,000. Core checks it before each model call; when the run has used this many tokens, it pauses with BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Raise it and rescue the run to continue.
CustomField.label: Max Total Tokens
